title: Bifurcation of limit cycles in a class of piecewise smooth generalized Abel equations with two asymmetric zones
summary: This paper studies the number of limit cycles, known as the Smale-Pugh problem, for the generalized Abel equation \begin{align*} \frac{dx}{dθ}=A(θ)x^p+B(θ)x^q, \end{align*} where $A$ and $B$ are are piecewise trigonometrical polynomials of degree $ m $ with two zones $0\leqθ<θ_1$ and $θ_1\leqθ\leq2π$.
